channel.title: California AgTech Alliance Newsroom
channel.description: Official press releases and media advisories from the California AgTech Alliance, with the media contact, boilerplate, key facts, and logos.

item.title: 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape maps more than 400 companies worldwide
item.description: The new edition maps more than 400 companies building robots for food crops, nearly 25% more than in 2024; more than 40% of the U.S. companies are in California.

item.title: Media Invited to 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape Launch
item.description: Reporters were invited to the September 16 webinar releasing the 2026 Crop Robotics Landscape, with a panel on adoption, validation and the agricultural workforce.

item.title: CDFA, UC ANR and partners introduce California Agricultural Research and Innovation Roadmap
item.description: CDFA, UC ANR and partners, including the Alliance, introduce a roadmap of 10-year research priorities and innovation priorities that the Alliance leads and updates every two years.

item.title: California AgTech Alliance launches to help farmers stay competitive
item.description: UC ANR, CDFA and GO-Biz launch a $15 million statewide partnership with nine regional innovation hubs and more than 50 partner organizations.

item.title: California AgTech Alliance to Launch at FIRA USA Oct. 22
item.description: Reporters were invited to the Alliance’s launch at FIRA USA in Woodland, with UC ANR’s Gabriel Youtsey and CDFA Secretary Karen Ross.
